tooltip.hold_for_perspective.base_toolti: What perspective should the mod put you in when holding your toggle perspective key?
tooltip.hold_for_perspective.first_perso: This is the perspective where you look through your character's eyes
tooltip.hold_for_perspective.third_perso: This is the perspective where your camera is behind your character and looks in front of them
This is the perspective where your camera is in front of your character and looks at their face
tooltip.hold_for_perspective.no_keybind: This setting only has an effect when the mod is enabled. You can set a keybind in the keybinds settings.
tooltip.hold_for_perspective.only_when_e: This setting only has an effect when the mod is enabled. You can toggle it at any time with %1$s.
hold_for_perspective.mod_enabled: Toggled the Hold For Perspective mod on
hold_for_perspective.mod_disabled: Toggled the Hold For Perspective mod off
